categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Allist Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. focuses on innovative drug development, production, and commercialization primarily in the oncology field, especially targeting non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). The company develops first-in-class and best-in-class small molecule targeted therapies, with core products including the third-generation EGFR-TKI drug, furmonertinib (AST2818). It also engages in licensing and commercialization of other oncology drugs such as pralsetinib and KRAS G12C inhibitors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced drug molecular design and discovery technologies, including computer-aided drug design and metabolism-based drug optimization. It has a complete new drug R&D system covering lead compound discovery, preclinical and clinical research, registration, industrialization, and commercialization. Production follows GMP standards, with proprietary manufacturing of furmonertinib tablets through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Jiangsu Allist Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals and healthcare providers across China, with a marketing network covering over 4,800 hospitals nationwide. The end markets are patients with NSCLC and other cancers requiring targeted therapies. The company also serves pharmaceutical partners through licensing and commercialization agreements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with a nationwide sales and marketing network covering 31 provinces and municipalities. It has ongoing international clinical collaborations, notably with ArriVent BioPharma in the U.S., to advance global clinical development and commercialization of its core products.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Allist operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug R&D, manufacturing, and commercialization. It holds marketing authorization for its core products and manages production through its subsidiary, ensuring supply chain control from development to market delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on innovative oncology drug development targeting unmet clinical needs in NSCLC, emphasizing first-in-class and best-in-class small molecule targeted therapies. R&D priorities include expanding indications for furmonertinib, developing new drugs for EGFR mutations, KRAS G12C inhibitors, and combination therapies. The company also pursues external collaborations and licensing to enrich its oncology pipeline and accelerate global clinical development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary oncology drugs, especially furmonertinib. Additional revenue streams include licensing fees, royalties from out-licensed products, and service income from drug promotion and marketing activities. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Allist is positioned as a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company in China’s oncology sector, particularly in targeted therapies for NSCLC. It competes with domestic and international pharmaceutical companies developing EGFR-TKIs and other targeted cancer therapies. The company’s proprietary third-generation EGFR-TKI with strong clinical differentiation provides competitive advantages in the market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 3.56 billion, a 76.29% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.43 billion, up 121.97%. The company has shown rapid growth driven by increased sales of furmonertinib and expanded reimbursement coverage. Total assets reached RMB 5.92 billion, with strong cash flow generation and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Allist emphasizes its innovative drug portfolio with proprietary intellectual property, focusing on drugs with superior efficacy, safety, and brain penetration for NSCLC patients. Furmonertinib offers significant clinical benefits including extended progression-free survival and effectiveness against brain metastases, differentiating it from competitors. The company’s integrated R&D, manufacturing, and commercialization capabilities, along with a nationwide marketing network, enhance patient access and market penetration.
